# Vendored third-party code

`elk.bundled.js` is elkjs 0.9.3 (`elkjs@0.9.3/lib/elk.bundled.js`, the Eclipse Layout
Kernel compiled to JavaScript), vendored third-party code. It is copied here unchanged,
sha256 `b0745abd7f23cd91690a1587e377edbe19fd7233c783300290936720546216d4`, and it is
licensed under the Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0), whose text is in `LICENSE`
beside it.

The v5 page inlines it ahead of the kit's modules, so the page lays out its drawings
without loading anything over the network. Do not edit it: replace it with another
release of elkjs as a whole, and update this note and the hash with it. The kit's
size and dash rules leave this file out by name.
